## (b) Changed files, cause and design

Diff base `51521cf` (round 6's combined fix, which contains M1's approved `3f00b57`). My commits: `217489c` (code),
`41a25f4` (test), `77ba760` (code: outgoing-layer freeze), the merge of M7b `eea543d`, `49ea1de` (CSS: the
summary note's text keeps beside its button in narrow panels), then the packet commit (see (a)).

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `src/app/flow.ts` | **Removed** the warning toast and everything that placed or held it: `SAVE_TOAST_ID`, `TOAST_ZONE_PX`, `SETTLE_MS`/`WATCH_MS`, the `warning` hold state and its 250 ms watcher, `ritualOnScreen()`, `protectedUnderToasts()`, `warningWouldBlock()`, `toastOnScreen()`, `showSaveWarning()`, `watchSaveWarning()`, `recheckSaveWarning()` and its three call sites (`timer:start`, `timer:complete`, `timer:sync`), the `toastLiftBottom`/`downloadBackup` imports. **Kept** M1's detection and wiring: `onStorageWriteError(warnSaveFailed)` in `initFlow()`; `warnSaveFailed` now hands the failure to the banner state. End-early toast: "Saved N minutes of focus" only when saving works; while it fails, "N minutes of focus, kept in this tab: not saved yet". |
| `src/app/saveWarning.ts` (new) | The warning **state** (zustand): on at the first failed save, off once every key whose save failed has been saved again (`lastWriteFailed`, re-checked every 2 s while on — storage state, no geometry). "Save backup" action (`downloadBackup`, the existing success / failure toasts). A polite live region of its own (`#kettle-save-warning-said`, created at start-up), set **once per spell of failing saves** when the first banner/note shows (at most once a minute). `captureAnchor()`/`settleAnchor()`: when the banner appears or goes while its screen is open, the element under the last pointer/touch (or keyboard focus) is kept where it was by scrolling its scroller by however far it moved, before paint. |

Each follows the warning only while its own route is current and no brew or break has just started on it, so an outgoing layer (Today dissolving into the brew, the summary into the break) never grows one, even when the start's own save fails a moment before the route changes (`77ba760`). Honey tint (`--honey-soft`, `--honey-soft-edge`, `--honey` icon tile), `--ink` text, the cards' `--r-lg` and 2 px edge, body type; no motion. |

| `src/screens/settings/DataSection.tsx` | The same banner right after the "Your data" rows (Export / Import / Reset). |
| `src/screens/done/Summary.tsx` | `<SaveWarningNote/>` under the headline: "Not saved: storage is full." + **Save backup** (or "Not saved in this browser."). |
| `src/ui/Toast.tsx` | `toastLiftBottom()` no longer exported (only flow.ts's warning used it). No behaviour change. |
| `src/ui/Toast.module.css` | Comments only (they described the warning); every rule unchanged, so the remaining toasts keep their round-6 behaviour, including action toasts leading a short-room stack. |
| `src/app/saveWarning.test.ts` (new) | Unit: state comes with the first failure, stays 10 min with storage full, stays while any failed key is still unsaved, goes when all are saved, a later failure is a new episode; copy never says "saved". |
| `tests/integrity.spec.ts` | **Only** the block "I03 storage-full warning never covers a control (…)" replaced (diff proof below). |
| `tests/toast-room.spec.ts` | The 8 warning-toast tests replaced by banner tests; the 2 "last toast fades out" tests unchanged. |
| `docs/areas/timer.md`, `docs/areas/progress.md` | "Storage full" rewritten for the banner. |

**Cause addressed.** Six rounds of the same symptom came from one coupling: M1's rule decided whether the data-safety
warning could be visible by polling the warning's laid-out box, and M2's toast layout decided where that box was. The
warning is no longer in the toast layer at all, so no toast, lift, list order, list scroll, anchoring, entry
transform or other toast's lifecycle can move, hide or withdraw it; and nothing measures geometry to decide whether it
may show. Where it shows is a property of the screens that include it.

**Design notes (benchmarks opened: K01 `01-home.png`, K02 `07-summary.png`, K09 `live-settings.jpg`).**
- *Transferred:* K01/K09's card language (cream/plum surfaces, 2 px edge, large radius, Nunito body, Fredoka on the
  button) for a calm block that reads as part of the page; K02's compact one-line rows for the summary note, so the
  summary stays compact and its last line still clears the Tea time / Skip footer.
- *Not copied / avoided:* K01's orange (focus) and K02's blue (rest) action colours, berry (alarm), any motion; the
  greeting, Chai, status bar, categories, brew length, docked start ("· 25 min") and the sky "Change brew length"
  link are untouched.
- *Copy:* "This browser’s storage is full. Kettle couldn’t save your latest changes. Save a backup to keep them." —
  M1's approved wording, split into a bold title and a sentence. Blocked storage: "Kettle can’t save in this
  browser. Your latest changes are only in this tab. Save a backup to keep them." Summary: "Not saved: storage is full."
- *Nothing under the finger moves:* a banner rendered with the screen is part of its first layout (CLS measured in
  (c3)). A banner that appears while the screen is open (e.g. a real tap on "Mark done" with storage full) keeps the
  element under the finger/pointer/focus still: what sits above the banner moves up instead (measured in (c3)).
- *Said once:* the banner is a named region, not a live region; one polite announcement per spell of failing saves.

## (f) BLOCKED / UNKNOWN (never PASS)

- **BLOCKED:** real phones and touch hardware (all touch here is CDP touch under mobile emulation); real wheel notch
  sizes; real OS text-size settings (200 % here is `html{font-size:200%}`); real window managers; **real assistive
  technology** (the single polite announcement and the banner's region name were checked in the DOM / live-region
  mutations only, not heard on VoiceOver, TalkBack or NVDA); real-device performance and GPU timing (SwiftShader,
  4 shared CPUs, other lanes running).
- **UNKNOWN:** iOS Safari / WebKit and Firefox: `scrollBy({behavior:'instant'})` inside a layout effect (the
  "nothing moves under the finger" compensation), `:has()`, and the honey tint's rendering; whether a screen reader
  re-reads a named `<section>` when Today is visited again (it is not a live region, so it should not).
- **Not in scope, recorded for the owners:**
  - `src/timer/announce.ts` (M1/timer, out of my files): ending early while saving fails, the screen-reader line
    still says "Kettle’s off. N minutes of focus saved." (the visible toast no longer does). Follow-up for M1.
  - Stats and Nook do not show the banner (only Today, Settings › Your data and the summary do, as required). A save
    that fails there is announced once and shown on the next visit to Today or Settings.
  - Landscape phones at 200 % text: the docked start leaves a strip of about 75 px above it in the right column
    (pre-existing, follow-ups 3/12); the banner, like the composer, is read by scrolling through that strip.

## (c) Step-2 probes (real input, real timers, fresh contexts, disposable profiles)

Every run: its own Chromium launch through `tools/slots.py --lane M7a --n 1`, a fresh context (disposable profile),
SwiftShader, DPR 2 and touch for widths under 900. Inputs are real (`page.mouse.wheel`, CDP touch through
`locator.tap()` / `Input.dispatchTouchEvent`, real clicks). Toast timers are real and nothing is held: no synthetic
`pointerenter`, no programmatic scrolling, no test-only timer changes. The debug API is used for setup only (seed,
quota fill, `startFocus`, `ff`, `end`). "M7a" rows are the **final combined revision `49ea1de`** (`kettle/src` `939711c`) on my dev
server :5206, restarted on that tree; controls on the orchestrator's servers.

**Probe adaptation.** Each probe now measures *whichever element presents the warning*: the toast
`li#toast-kettle:save-failed` (judged exactly as before) or the banner `section[data-save-warning]` (judged for being
taken away or faded, moving within the page — `top + scrollY` — and its Save backup outside its box or clipped by an
ancestor). Both also count every addition of the warning's text to a live region (`aria-live` / `status` / `alert`).
Diffs against the round-6 originals: `r7/M7a/probes/natural-b.diff`, `actionpair-b.diff`, `pwapair-b.diff`
(originals copied beside them; `SHA256.txt`). One setup change in the LEAD probes, applied to control and revision
alike: **no newbie seed** — after midnight UTC the seed's sessions sort after the new brew, so Today offers no "Mark
done" (the original probe's own guard throws "no Mark done link"); the brew, End, quota fill and real tap are as before.

### Fixed (mandatory, added after the merge): three toasts over the session top bar's Close

**Defect** (found by M7b, introduced in round 7 by the combination: M7b made Break's over scroll at 200 % text, and
round 6's toast room ran from the top safe edge down to the lift above the action group): at 375×667 @200 %, Break's
over scrolled to its end, a 3-toast stack fills the room up over the top bar and covers **Close**.

**Fix** (`src/ui/Toast.tsx`, `de7e261`; no CSS rule changed): the room now starts below the screen's top bar.
`toastRoomTop()` finds a visible page-level `<header>` (the banner landmark: not inside `main`, `section`, `article`,
`aside`, `nav`, `aria-hidden` or `inert`; within the top 40 % of the screen; not faded out, e.g. the zen chrome) and
sets the region's `top` to its bottom + 24 px (the list's 20 px shadow padding, which its scrollport covers, plus
4 px). A stack taller than the room scrolls inside it as before. Screens without such a bar — Today, Stats, Nook,
Settings — get no `top` and keep the room exactly as before. The room is now measured in a layout effect, so a new
stack is never painted for a frame in the old room (the 250 ms re-measure and the resize listener are unchanged).

**Probe** `r7/M7a/probes/closecheck.mjs` (new): fresh context per run; seed, brew and finish through the debug API
(setup); a real tap on "Tea time"; the panel scrolled to its end by **real wheel** or **CDP touch drags**; three
toasts raised through the app's own `toast()` with its default timers (labelled setup; nothing held); every animation
frame for 1.2 s: Close, "Mark it done, start fresh", "Put the kettle on" and "That's all for now" hit-tested at their
centres and their boxes checked against every toast box (clipped by the list's scrollport); then a **real tap / click**
at one control's centre while the three toasts are still up, and the click's target recorded. One run per control
(4 per input method), so every control is really tapped.

**Regression test:** `tests/toast-room.spec.ts` "three toasts never cover the session top bar's Close or a Break's over
